text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having declared that she'll beat Tokai Teio, Nice Nature is filled with instant regret and screams her frustrations into a hollow stump.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her beside herself with anxiety, I express my deep support for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Realizing she's got me and the whole shopping district backing her, she decides she needs to stop whining and pulls herself together.
